encode_text_to_byte_chars: encode a string to byte-level characters using byte_encode for fairseq bpe tokenization
decode_byte_chars_to_text: decode byte-level characters back to the original string using byte_decode
recover_broken_byte_text: recover the best valid text from broken byte-encoded strings using smart_byte_decode with dynamic programming
test_byte_encode_decode_roundtrip: test that byte_encode and byte_decode roundtrip correctly for a given input string
review_byte_utils_constants: review the PRINTABLE_LATIN set and BYTE_TO_BCHAR mapping used for byte-level character encoding
